## Plan → landed

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| `GET /v1/releases/{pub or latest}/search` federated | `api/release_search_v2.py` `ReleaseSearchV2Store` + the `SIG_API_SEARCH_V2`-gated route in `app.py` — `off` mounts nothing (identical public response to pre-roll), `on` serves; unknown posture fails closed at construction |
| streaming verify-and-copy | `_copy_verified` streams each artifact in 1 MiB chunks while hashing; sha256 + byte_size must match the integrity manifest before any `mode=ro` open; a drift fails 503, never silently served (K3 §5.5 / NEW-2) |
| LRU | `_engines` OrderedDict, `max_engines=2` default (latest + one pinned ≈ 200 MB, K3 §5.5); eviction closes connections and drops the local copies |
| `latest` via conf-gen (REL-05) | `resolve()` reads `latest.json`; no pointer → 503 `no_current_release`; a `latest` answer carries `max-age=300`, a `p-<sha>` answer `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` |
| scope counts with denials (DR-C4-09) | the same one P32.5 policy at access time — route/namespace deny → 410; entity denies direct; claim denies resolve through `claim_ref` once per request (never per row); `excluded_records_by_reason` counts under the same deadline |
| rate limiter keyed on the LB client address | the P36.13 app-wide middleware already covers the route (test asserts headers + a 429 under enforce); `SIG_API_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=2` slices the LB chain |
| no query logging (SIG-SRCH-012) | the module never logs; `test_no_query_logging` pins it |
| cache headers + OpenAPI | `cache_control()` per pointer-class; the route appears in `/openapi.json` only when armed |
| sig-api 512 MiB → 1 GiB (+$3/mo) | `ops/gcp/config.sh` `SIG_API_MEMORY="1Gi"` + `provision.sh --memory` (D-K3-5 [B-30] = yes); the live bump rides the roll |
| the API roll | `ops/gcp/search-v2-roll.sh` (check/apply/verify; window guard + verbatim-go author env) + `reports/p36.38-search-v2-roll/` packet — `prepared_not_executed` (D-P36.38-1) |
| `format=html` | typed 501 `html_representation_pending` — P36.39 owns the representation; never silent JSON |

## Test matrix (23 tests — `uv run pytest tests/api/test_release_search_v2.py`, ~12 s)

Posture: off mounts nothing + absent from OpenAPI · env drives posture,
unknown fails closed · enabled-without-store 503. Federation: envelope,
both compartments in one request, `latest` resolves + `max-age=300`,
pub-pinned `immutable`, identifier hit, `type=` filter, group-cursor
round-trip, OpenAPI presence. Errors: unknown/malformed pub 404,
unsupported params 422, cursor mismatch 409, `format=html` 501, tampered
bytes 503, missing file 503, v1-era release 404
`v2_indexes_not_published`. Barrier: entity deny filters + counts, claim
deny filters carrier, release deny 410 + tombstone. Privacy/limits: no
server-side query log record; rate headers + 429 on the route. LRU:
eviction drops copies.

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **`location`/`within` refused 422** — the K3 §5.1 sketch lists them;
   the landed v2 engine (P36.32) has no such parameters, so they land in
   `unsupported_query` explicitly rather than being silently ignored.
2. **`format=html` answers 501** — P36.39 owns the no-JS representation;
   a typed refusal over silent JSON (recorded, never re-decided).
3. **`SIG_API_SEARCH_V2` posture: `off` = not mounted** — the public
   response is byte-identical to pre-roll (a 404), the truest dark-ship;
   `on` mounts. An unknown value refuses boot (fail closed).
4. **Claim-denial resolution** — the v2 record index carries no claims
   column, so denied claim ids resolve to record keys through each
   compartment's `claim_ref` once per request (bounded by the same
   deadline), never a per-row lookup.
